request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Turn it into a stone-age war raft: the pale hull becomes big tied logs of warm tawny wood, colour #a2804b with #6e4f26 shadows, with cream bone fittings; the bow becomes a big carved plesiosaur head painted deep blue #205794 with bold orange #fe7500 stripes; the grey tower becomes a hide hut; the red sails become dull sandy brown animal hide, colour #a67c3d, with big bold dark brown spots; the pennants become orange feathers. Keep the ship shape, size, with nothing under the hull.
